announcements.title: MetaHumans with AI Powered Conversation, Lip Sync, and Facial Animation | Convai Unreal Engine Tutorial
announcements.description: This tutorial demonstrates how to integrate Convai with MetaHuman avatars in Unreal Engine for natural real-time voice conversations with accurate lip sync and facial animation. Using the updated Convai Unreal Engine plugin and Convai's in-house neural animation system, NeuroSync, live audio is processed in real time to drive expressive facial performance across MetaHuman blend shapes. It covers end-to-end setup, from connecting a Convai character to configuring speech input and facial animation for production-ready interactive experiences.

announcements.title: AI Characters with Streaming Vision Input and Handsfree Interactions | Convai Unreal Engine Tutorial
announcements.description: This video introduces the new Convai Unreal Engine plugin powered by Convai's latest Live Character API. Built on WebRTC for low-latency real-time interactions, it brings advanced capabilities including streaming vision input, multimodal knowledge, and long-term memory. Together, these features enable AI characters to see, understand, remember, and engage in richer context-aware conversations.

announcements.title: Build Vision based Conversational AI Characters | Convai Unity Tutorial
announcements.description: In this video, we introduce the new Convai Unity Plugin, powered by Convai's latest Live Character API. Built on WebRTC, it enables low-latency real-time interactions and introduces powerful capabilities including real-time vision input, multimodal knowledge, and long-term memory. Together, these features allow AI characters to see, understand, remember, and engage in rich, context-aware conversations.
